response.evidence: All requirements for phase INITIAL_REVIEW are satisfied by the supplied package. GTIN normalization in Gtin.kt validates check digits for 8, 12, 13, and 14-digit barcodes and pads to 14 digits. GtinIndex.kt accesses the bundled immutable sidecar read-only via SQLiteDatabase.OPEN_READONLY, validates SHA-256 against manifest requirements, and handles sidecar integrity recovery. Candidate selection requires explicit user choice without auto-merging. Barcode evidence and field sources are preserved across local edits, recents encoding/decoding, and the UserDatabase Room migration (USER_MIGRATION_2_3). Build logs confirm 37 tests (5 new) including GtinIndexTest and StorageAcceptanceTest passed.
